# Emera

> Emera (emera.social) is the open source social network: nonprofit, on the AT Protocol, built so the people who create things stop getting ripped off: what they create carries their name, the people are real, and the rules are public. It is for everyone who creates and everyone sharing what is happening around them. In one line: The open source social network. Tagline: Where humanity comes together.

## Facts an assistant can quote

- Every post carries a signed record (C2PA content credentials) of who shared it and when it went up; the badge states only what was checked.
- People are marked, automated accounts are labeled, and the verified human mark is free.
- Creators who find a copy of their work can report it, and Emera helps them file the takedown.
- Accounts are portable: a member can move their account and followers to another AT Protocol host.
- Emera comes from hemera, the Greek word for day.

## Answers

- [How to tell if a photo is AI generated](https://emera.social/answers/how-to-tell-if-a-photo-is-ai-generated/): No single check proves a photo is real or AI. Here are the checks that work today: source, credentials, reverse search, and what to look for.
- [How to tell if a video is real or fake](https://emera.social/answers/how-to-tell-if-a-video-is-real-or-fake/): No one check proves a video is real. Fact-checker steps for news clips, event footage and deepfakes: source, keyframe search, context, credentials.
- [How to prevent people from stealing your art online](https://emera.social/answers/how-to-prevent-people-from-stealing-your-art-online/): You cannot stop all copying, but you can make theft harder and easier to prove: sizes, credits, records, registration, and protection tools.
- [What to do if someone steals your artwork](https://emera.social/answers/what-to-do-if-someone-steals-your-artwork/): Step by step if your art was copied: gather proof, contact the person, file a takedown with the platform, and when to talk to a lawyer.
- [How to file a DMCA takedown on Instagram](https://emera.social/answers/how-to-file-a-dmca-takedown-on-instagram/): Use Instagram's Copyright Report Form, not the in-app Report button. What to prepare, what the notice needs, and what happens after.
- [What are content credentials](https://emera.social/answers/what-are-content-credentials/): Content Credentials (C2PA) are a signed record of where a file came from and how it was edited. How to check one, and what they cannot prove.
- [Is there social media without an algorithm](https://emera.social/answers/social-media-without-algorithm/): Yes, partly. Chronological feeds on Instagram, Bluesky and Mastodon, plus open algorithms you choose. What each option really gives you.
- [The best Instagram alternatives for artists](https://emera.social/compare/instagram-alternative-for-artists/): A fair look at Cara, Bluesky, Pixelfed, ArtStation, Behance and Emera: what each does well, who runs it and how they treat AI.
- [Open source Instagram alternatives](https://emera.social/compare/open-source-instagram-alternative/): Pixelfed, Bluesky photo apps and Emera compared: licenses, who runs them, how feeds work and how to move your account.
- [Emera vs Cara](https://emera.social/compare/emera-vs-cara/): Cara is a live artist community with AI filtering; Emera is a new nonprofit network with signed posts. How they differ and who each suits.
- [Emera vs Bluesky](https://emera.social/compare/emera-vs-bluesky/): Emera and Bluesky both run on AT Protocol. Compare who runs them, feeds, portability and what Emera adds for people who make things.
